title: Forth in Your Name, O Lord, I Go
scripture: "Whatever you do, do all to the glory of God." — 1 Cor 10:31
verses:
Forth in Thy Name, O Lord, I go,
My daily labor to pursue;
Thee, only Thee, resolved to know
In all I think, or speak, or do.

The task Thy wisdom hath assigned
O let me cheerfully fulfill;
In all my works Thy presence find,
And prove Thy good and perfect will.

Preserve me from my calling's snare,
And hide my simple heart above;
Any toil, if Thou art there,
Is changed to joyful work and love.

Thee may I set at my right hand,
Whose eyes my inmost substance see;
And labor on at Thy command,
And offer all my works to Thee.

Give me to bear Thy easy yoke,
And every moment watch and pray;
And still to things eternal look,
And hasten to Thy glorious day.

title: Holy Father, Hear Me
scripture: "O, God early will I seek Thee." — Ps 63:1
verses:
Holy Father, hear me,
For Thy mercy's sake;
Hear me, gracious Father,
While my prayer I make.

As the morning breaketh,
Lord, I come to Thee;
In the name of Jesus,
Hear my morning plea.

For the sin of yesterday,
Lord, forgive me now;
At Thy throne of mercy,
Humbly I bow.

Keep me through this day, Lord,
In the narrow way;
Let Thy grace and wisdom
Guide me day by day.

title: From All the Dangers of the Night
verses:
From all the dangers of the night,
Preserved by Thy almighty hand,
Again I see the morning light,
Again before Thy face I stand.

To Thee my grateful heart would raise
A song of triumph and of praise;
For Thy protection all the night,
And for the morning's cheerful light.

O Lord, my strength, be Thou my guide,
Through all this day of toil and care;
Be Thou my help, my guard, my pride,
And keep me in Thy tender prayer.

To Father, Son, and Holy Ghost,
For ever be all glory given;
With all the bright angelic host,
Who praise Thee night and day in heaven.

title: Come to the Morning Pray'r
verses:
Come to the morning prayer,
Come let us kneel before the Lord;
His praise and glory to declare,
And hear His holy Word.

The night is past and gone,
The shadows flee away;
Now let us greet the rising sun,
And walk in light today.

Lord, bless our going out,
Lord, bless our coming in;
Encompass us with grace about,
And save our souls from sin.

To God the Father, Son,
And Spirit, glory be;
As was of old, is now, and shall
Be through eternity.

title: Awake My Soul and with the Sun
scripture: "Awake, my glory! Awake, lute and harp!" — Ps 57:8
verses:
Awake, my soul, and with the sun
Thy daily stage of duty run;
Shake off dull sloth, and joyful rise
To pay thy morning sacrifice.

Direct, control, suggest, this day,
All I design, or do, or say;
That all my powers, with all their might,
In Thy sole glory may unite.

title: Come to Me Lord, when First I  Wake.
verses:
Come to me, Lord, when first I wake,
Before my soul its armour take;
Before my thoughts on any thing,
But Thee, the Lord of all, begin.

Come with Thy presence and Thy grace,
Before I seek a single face;
Let me behold Thee, Lord, and then
Go forth to meet my fellow men.

Come, that I may not step aside
From Thee this day, my heavenly Guide;
But ever walk with Thee in sight,
From morning's dawn to closing night.

Come, lest the world should make me lose
The path Thou wouldst have me to choose;
Let Thy dear face be ever near
To guide and guard through mortal fear.

Come, that the final hour may find
Me blameless still in heart and mind;
That I may stand at Thy right hand
Among the blessed of every land.

title: Once More the Sun Is Beaming
scripture: "Commit thy way unto the Lord;" — Ps 37:5
verses:
Once more the sun is beaming bright,
Once more we see the morning light;
To God our Heavenly King we raise
Our morning hymn of thankful praise.

Lord, keep us safe through all this day,
From sin and error turn away;
In all we do, in all we speak,
Thy holy guidance may we seek.

Grant us Thy peace, Thy grace impart,
To rule and reign in every heart;
Till earthly days and nights shall cease,
In Thine eternal realm of peace.

title: The Morning Bright with Rosy Light
scripture: "He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust." — Ps 91:4
verses:
The morning bright with rosy light
Has waked the child from sleep;
Father, Thy child again would pray,
Thy child would praise and weep.

Thou hast kept me through the night,
Safe beneath Thy wings;
Now the morning light is bright,
Joy and peace it brings.

Keep me, Lord, from doing wrong,
Keep me pure within;
Make me faithful all day long,
Safe from every sin.

title: Awake My Soul and Rise with Joy
scripture: "I will mention the loving kindness of the LORD." — Isa 63:7
verses:
Awake, my soul, and rise with joy,
To praise thy Maker's name;
Let highest praise thy tongue employ,
His goodness to proclaim.

His mercies every morning new,
Demand a song of praise;
He leads us all our journey through,
And guards us all our days.

To God the Father, God the Son,
And God the Holy Ghost,
Be praise and glory ever done,
By all the heavenly host.

title: There Is Sunshine in the Valley
scripture: "And the light shineth in darkness." — John 1.5
verses:
There is sunshine in the valley today,
There is brightness along the way;
For the Saviour is near, all our trials to cheer,
And to wipe every tear away.

Though the shadows may gather around,
Yet in Jesus true comfort is found;
He will lighten our load on the heavenly road,
And His blessings will ever abound.

In His presence is fullness of joy,
Praise eternal our lips shall employ;
With the redeemed above in the kingdom of love,
Nothing ever our peace can destroy.

[Refrain]
There is sunshine, blessed sunshine,
In the valley where Jesus abides;
There is sunshine, heavenly sunshine,
When we walk with the Saviour as guides.

title: Love Divine, All Loves Excelling
scripture: "The greatest of these is charity" — 1 Cor. 13:13
verses:
Love divine, all loves excelling,
Joy of heaven, to earth come down,
Fix in us Thy humble dwelling,
All Thy faithful mercies crown.
Jesus, Thou art all compassion,
Pure, unbounded love Thou art;
Visit us with Thy salvation,
Enter every trembling heart.

Breathe, O breathe Thy loving Spirit
Into every troubled breast;
Let us all in Thee inherit,
Let us find that second rest.
Take away our bent to sinning,
Alpha and Omega be;
End of faith, as its beginning,
Set our hearts at liberty.

Come, Almighty, to deliver,
Let us all Thy grace receive;
Suddenly return, and never,
Nevermore Thy temples leave.
Thee we would be always blessing,
Serve Thee as Thy hosts above,
Pray, and praise Thee without ceasing,
Glory in Thy perfect love.

Finish then Thy new creation,
Pure and spotless let us be;
Let us see Thy great salvation
Perfectly restored in Thee:
Changed from glory into glory,
Till in heaven we take our place,
Till we cast our crowns before Thee,
Lost in wonder, love, and praise.

title: We Are Never Never Weary of the Grand Old Song

We are never, never weary of the grand old song,
Glory to God, hallelujah!
We can sing it loud and cheerily the whole day long,
Glory to God, hallelujah!

We are dwelling in the Beulah land of light divine,
Glory to God, hallelujah!
Where the radiant beams of heavenly glory shine,
Glory to God, hallelujah!

We will praise Him for the victory again and again,
Glory to God, hallelujah!
We will tell the wondrous story to the sons of men,
Glory to God, hallelujah!

[Refrain]
O, the children of the Lord have a right to shout and sing,
For the Lord is on the throne, and He reigns as King!
Glory to God, hallelujah!

title: Come, Let Us Join Our Cheerful Songs

Come, let us join our cheerful songs

Ten thousand thousand are their tongues,
But all their joys are one.

"Worthy the Lamb that died," they cry,
"To be exalted thus;"
"Worthy the Lamb," our lips reply,
"For He was slain for us."

Jesus is worthy to receive
Honor and power divine;
And blessings more than we can give,
Be, Lord, forever Thine.

Let all that dwell above the sky,
And air, and earth, and seas,
Conspire to lift Thy glories high,
And speak Thine endless praise.

Our Shield and Defender, the Ancient of Days,
Pavillioned in splendour and girded with praise.

O tell of His might, O sing of His grace,
Whose robe is the light, whose canopy space;
His chariots of wrath the deep thunderclouds form,
And dark is His path on the wings of the storm.

The earth with its store of wonders untold,
Almighty, Thy power hath founded of old;
Established it fast by a changeless decree,
And round it hath cast, like a mantle, the sea.

Thy bountiful care what tongue can recite?
It breathes in the air, it shines in the light;
It streams from the hills, it descends to the plain,
And sweetly distills in the dew and the rain.

Frail children of dust, and feeble as frail,
In Thee do we trust, nor find Thee to fail;
Thy mercies how tender, how firm to the end,
Our Maker, Defender, Redeemer and Friend.

From Thy riven side which flowed,

Save from wrath and make me pure.

When mine eyes shall close in death,
When I soar to worlds unknown,
See Thee on Thy judgment throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.
